integration.finding: Original two-writer regression requires B to finish while A is paused after latest.json. A correct cross-file serialization lock would block B and make the test fail on its join timeout; this is a false-negative acceptance test for the intended repair. Replace the unconditional B.join with conditional wait for B's first latest write, and release A when B is serialized behind A.
integration.test_contract: No network, empty archive, shared tmp_path, A paused immediately after latest write, B either overtakes (pre-fix) or waits behind valid serialization (post-fix). Require both complete, no errors, archive absent, and one as_of_ms across all three persisted outputs. Existing source predicts [B,A,A], not executed.
integration.pytest_source:
import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from part2.capital_flow import runner

def test_two_writers_publish_coherent_generation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    a_latest, release_a, b_latest = (threading.Event() for _ in range(3))
    original = runner.atomic_write_json
    def gated(path, payload):
        original(path, payload)
        if Path(path).name == "latest.json":
            if threading.current_thread().name == "writer-A":
                a_latest.set()
                assert release_a.wait(20), "A release timeout"
            elif threading.current_thread().name == "writer-B":
                b_latest.set()
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "atomic_write_json", gated)
    errors = []
    def run(timestamp):
        try:
            runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False,
                            external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=timestamp)
        except BaseException as exc:
            errors.append(repr(exc))
    a = threading.Thread(target=run, args=(1800000000000,), name="writer-A")
    b = threading.Thread(target=run, args=(1800000060000,), name="writer-B")
    a.start()
    try:
        assert a_latest.wait(20), "A did not write latest"
        b.start()
        if b_latest.wait(10):  # no cross-file lock: B can overtake A
            b.join(20)
            assert not b.is_alive(), "B failed to complete after first write"
    finally:
        release_a.set()
        a.join(20)
        if b.ident is not None:
            b.join(20)
    assert not a.is_alive() and not b.is_alive()
    assert not errors, errors
    assert not (tmp_path / "observations.jsonl").exists()
    names = ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json")
    stamps = [json.loads((tmp_path / n).read_text())["as_of_ms"] for n in names]
    assert len(set(stamps)) == 1, dict(zip(names, stamps))
